summary.text: Christine F. Watkins is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 67, covering Carbon, Duchesne, Emery and Grand counties. She served in the Legislature from 2009 to 2012 and again since 2017, and is House Chair of the Native American Liaison Committee.

paragraphs.text: Watkins was born and raised in Cache Valley, graduated from high school in California, and earned a bachelor's degree in elementary education from Utah State University.
She holds a master's degree in educational leadership from the University of Utah and three special education endorsements from BYU.
She taught school in Castle Dale for 20 years and then worked for the Utah Education Association, and she serves as a board member of Castle View Hospital in Price.
